description: This Kotlin source file defines utility functions and constants used in the ai.openclaw.app.node package. It includes JSON parsing helpers, color processing, error handling, and other auxiliary functions for the app's node components.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a tuple of four elements of potentially different types.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-escaped string with surrounding quotes.

methods.name: asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Safely casts a JsonElement to a JsonObject if possible.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returns null if input is null, blank, or invalid.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonPrimitive value from a JsonObject for a given key.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a JsonObject for a specific key.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a JsonObject for a specific key.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Extracts a string value from a JsonObject for a specific key.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Extracts a boolean flag from a JsonObject for a specific key, interpreting string representations of booleans.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Returns the string content of a JsonElement if it is a JsonPrimitive, null otherwise.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Parses a hex color string into an ARGB Long value, with validation for format.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Creates a pair of error code and message from a Throwable, using a custom parsing function.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims and validates a raw string key; returns null if empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if the provided key is the canonical 'main' session key.
